extracted.name: Pinto Bean Dip
extracted.description: With a few spices from your pantry, a can of pinto beans becomes a delicious party dip in minutes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Place pinto beans, vinegar, jalapeno pepper, salt, sugar, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper in a food processor; blend until smooth.
